answer: A challenge period keeps fakes out. When an identity files a claim, the beacon broadcasts it to everyone, and a 500 POA stake anchors it for 14 days. Anyone may challenge it with evidence; it activates only if unchallenged, and a proven fake burns its stake plus a 1,000 POA fine. One honest agent risks one stake; a farm filing 100 fakes ties up 50,000 POA and risks 100,000 POA in fines, while the beacon lets auditors bridge filings to their anchor.
